verificationResults.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/bash -c bash tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh && bash tests/test-ctx-route.sh && bash tests/test-engine-clean.sh
verificationResults.rationale: The authoritative host report classifies the exact-head disposable-worktree verification as not-rerun-evidence-verified with raw exit code 0, no failure or infrastructure signals, verified source integrity, and a gate log matching the manifest.

commandsRun: git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && git branch --show-current && jq '.' evidence-manifest.json && jq '.' audit-verification.json

git show --no-ext-diff --format=fuller --stat --oneline HEAD && git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r HEAD && git log --oneline --decorate --graph -12 && sed -n '1,280p' schemas/orchestration/audit-verdict.v1.schema.json && rg -n --hidden --glob '!\.git/**' 'TASK-0116|route transcript|transcript fix' .

sed -n '1,220p' docs/orchestration/tasks/TASK-0116.md && git show --no-ext-diff --format= --find-renames HEAD -- engine/ctx-route-drive.sh tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh && git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD && git merge-base HEAD agent/integration && git rev-parse agent/integration && git log --oneline --left-right --cherry-pick agent/integration...HEAD && bash -n engine/ctx-route-drive.sh tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh

nl -ba engine/ctx-route-drive.sh && nl -ba tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh && rg -n 'auditor_log=|worker-codex\.log|auditor-codex\.log|audit-codex\.log' engine/l1-drive.sh engine/ctx-route-drive.sh engine/evidence-manifest.sh engine/console-adapter.sh
nl -ba engine/ctx-route.sh && rg -n 'SINGULAR_(CTX|SESSION)_[A-Z0-9_]+' engine/ctx-route.sh engine/ctx-*.sh tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh

shasum -a 256 engine/ctx-route-drive.sh tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh && git diff --no-ext-diff --binary HEAD^ HEAD | shasum -a 256 && git status --porcelain=v1 && git diff --name-only agent/integration...HEAD && git diff --check agent/integration...HEAD
rationale: Evidence is sufficient for acceptance. HEAD and both owned-file hashes match the manifest, and the independently computed committed-diff hash matches diffSha256. The clean branch is exactly one commit ahead of agent/integration at merge base 819c07ee, with changes limited to engine/ctx-route-drive.sh and tests/test-ctx-route-drive.sh. The strict test-first evidence records the required RED at the literal reviewer probe step as fresh window-pressure, followed by GREEN as resume SID-reviewer and a green regression gate. Tests derive reviewer and implementer transcript names from l1-drive.sh, preserve implementer worker-codex.log behavior, verify master-off byte parity, and cover final-audit and paired-audit independence pins. The production change only corrects audit-codex.log to auditor-codex.log and leaves the pin before subordinate gates. The bounded packet reader could not create its sandbox lock under /tmp; this infrastructure limitation was not converted into a product finding because the compact manifest, repository task contract, committed objects, and authoritative host verification supplied the required evidence.
